routeSelectionNote: Administrative Rule 40 is one rule and TF-805 is its form. The choice between the 40(b) ground and the 40(c) ground is a fact about the requester's own case rather than a consequence of the route, so this packet states the route it was built for and leaves that election, and the certificate-of-service method, to the participant.

selectionControls.reason: Administrative Rule 40 gives two grounds and this packet is built for the rule, not for one of them. Rule 40(b) is for issues of a sensitive and highly personal nature; Rule 40(c) is for a likelihood of substantial physical harm to members of your household, and the form notes that a 40(c) removal lasts five years and must then be renewed. Which fits your case is yours to say
